sections.title: Beyond the core group
sections.content: Petra (a colleague) and Tamás (a neighbor) are two new people worth being able to describe fully — putting a name, a relationship word, and an aki-clause together in one sentence.

items.spanish: Petra egy kolléganő, aki mindig segít.
items.english: Petra is a colleague who always helps.

items.spanish: Tamás olyan szomszéd, aki barátságos és vicces.
items.english: Tamás is a neighbor who is friendly and funny.

sections.content: mindig ("always") is straight from A1's frequency words — a small, familiar piece making a brand-new sentence about a brand-new person.
